edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Comm. Cant. Liber II 9

source_text: Ego flos campi et lilium convallium. Sicut lilium inter spinas, sic amica mea inter filias. Christus flos qui apparuit in campo mundi; lilium humilibus in valle. Ecclesia lilium inter spinas persecutionum et scandalorum. Spinae pungunt; lilium candorem servat.
pass_a_gloss: I flower of-field and lily of-valleys. As lily among thorns, so friend my among daughters...
pass_b_english: [[I am the flower of the field and the lily of the valleys. As a lily among thorns, so is my friend among the daughters >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:1-2]]. Christ is the flower that appeared in the field of the world; the lily for the lowly in the valley. The church is a lily among thorns of persecutions and scandals. Thorns prick; the lily keeps its brightness.
